mapper.insert: insert into review ( reviewId, reviewerId, revieweeId, reviewerType, postId, orderId, rating, content, reviewTime ) values ( #{reviewId}, #{reviewerId}, #{revieweeId}, #{reviewerType}, #{postId}, #{orderId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{reviewTime} )
mapper.select: select * from review where postId = #{postId} order by reviewTime desc
select * from review where reviewerId = #{reviewerId} order by reviewTime desc
select * from review where revieweeId = #{revieweeId} order by reviewTime desc
select count(*) from review where postId = #{postId}
select count(*) from review where postId = #{postId} and rating >= 4
select count(*) from review where revieweeId = #{revieweeId}
select count(*) from review where revieweeId = #{revieweeId} and rating >= 4
